name: Raiden
source:
Occupation: Assassin
Height: 6'
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Star Sign: Scorpio
Characteristics: Flighty, playful, charming, distracted
Affiliation: Hand of the Serpent

Raiden, at first glance, is a strange, unassuming young man. Though, if the rumors are true, he's actually Novus' infamous 'Snake in the Shadows'; an assassin so deadly that even other assassins fear him. You can decide if you think the title is befitting of him, but there's no doubt that you'll have an incredibly interesting time in his company.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/errant-kingdom]Kickstarter[/url]]

Raiden can be romanced on his own or as part of a polyamorous route with Lucien.
